## Research category

## Your idea or hypothesis
Describe the idea in accessible scientific language.

## Biological rationale
What mechanism or scientific observation motivates this idea?

What feedback, collaboration, or published evidence would help assess this idea?

Identify any relevant safety, clinical, biosafety, or regulatory uncertainties. Keep proposed experimental work at a conceptual level.
